Cc: legal@medisphere.com
Date: 2026-09-14T08:22:00Z
Subject: DPA + subprocessors + audit evidence request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Our InfoSec team needs to formalize the DPA and verify ongoing auditability before we can move forward with procurement. Can you confirm: 1) the current subprocessor inventory (including any cross-border transfers), 2) what evidence you can share for SOC 2 and the most recent penetration test (we usually ask for an executive summary), and 3) how audit rights will be handled (on-site vs. remote, frequency, and request lead time)?

We prefer execution via DocuSign if possible. If you can provide a redline copy and a short plan for evidence delivery, we can kick off legal review tomorrow.

Appreciate it — Laura

--
Laura Chen
Senior Procurement Manager, Medisphere Health
laura.chen@medisphere.com

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA + subprocessors + audit evidence request

Hi Laura — thanks, and glad to sync. Quick summary of what we can provide and proposed next steps below.

What we can provide today:
- Subprocessor inventory (current): AWS (us-east-1), S3 backups (cross-region replication to eu-west-1 only for DR), Datadog (monitoring), Sentry (errors), Stripe (billing). Full CSV is in the Drive link below.
- SOC 2 Type II: executive summary (attached) and auditor contact for more detail.
- Penetration test: we provide a redacted executive summary and critical/major finding remediations; full report available under NDA.
- Audit rights: our standard approach is remote evidence review + 2-year retention of audit logs. We support on-site vendor assessments for enterprise customers under a scoped, mutually agreed plan and with 30 days' notice.

Proposed next steps:
1) Attached is a DPA with our suggested redlines (redline_DPA_20260914.pdf). Key callouts: limited-scope audit rights (remote preferred), subprocessor notification cadence, and clarified cross-border transfers (SCCs where applicable).
2) If Medisphere accepts redlines in principle, we will push the final DPA to DocuSign (link will be shared) for signatures.
3) We can drop SOC2 executive summary and pen-test abstract into the shared Drive folder now; if you need the full pen test we can route under your NDA.

Timing: I can get the DocuSign envelope out by EOD tomorrow if legal confirms the redline is acceptable.

Attaching: redline_DPA_20260914.pdf, SOC2-type2-summary-2026.pdf, pen-test-abstract-2026.txt

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Trust — Redwood Inference

Tessa — quick notes for the thread before you send the envelope:
- Audit rights: confirm whether Medisphere wants a \"right to audit\" clause (we typically offer it as remote evidence review plus a single on-site option per 12 months for customers with an enterprise contract). Make sure redline language limits scope to Redwood systems only and excludes customer-provided data stores.
- Pen test: our policy is to share an executive summary and remediation timeline; full reports require the customer's signed NDA. Add that to the email copy.
- Subprocessors: add a monthly notification cadence for new subprocessors (or immediate notice for anything that affects data transfers).

If you want, I can prepare a short companion note for legal to accompany the DocuSign envelope describing the constrained audit scope and supporting evidence in Drive.

Karthik
Head of Privacy & Legal Operations
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Tessa,

Thanks — that plan looks good. A couple of clarifications from our side: 1) we prefer to retain the right to request up to one on-site (or remote equivalent) assessment per 12 months; 2) an NDA for the full pen test is fine — please send your standard mutual NDA and we'll execute it; 3) DocuSign timeline: EOD tomorrow works for us.

If you can include the companion note for legal (scope of audit & redaction policy) that will speed review. Once we get the DocuSign envelope we'll route through Medisphere legal and procurement.

Laura
